LanguageData.PaWT_G3c.label: HK G3 Custom
LanguageData.PaWT_G3c.description: The Heckler Koch Gewehr 3 Battle rifle, is a selective-fire automatic weapon that employs a roller-delayed blowback operating system, successor of CETME rifle and StG 45(Mauser). Rifle caliber, very accurate and somewhat controllable.
